name: @w6w-apps/googlechat
description: Post and manage Google Chat messages, spaces, memberships and reactions.

w6w.longDescription:
Google Chat brings a Workspace organization's team messaging into a workflow — posting and managing messages, spaces, memberships and reactions as the signed-in user. Actions cover creating and updating spaces (including setting one up as a direct message), posting, updating, deleting and searching messages within a space, and managing who belongs to a space, down to reacting to a specific message.

Threading is handled the way Google Chat expects: replying into an existing thread or starting a new one, with control over whether a missing thread should fail or silently start fresh. Retried create operations converge on the same resource rather than creating duplicates, so a workflow step that gets retried after a network hiccup does not double-post.

This app acts strictly as a human user — the messages and spaces it touches are ones the connected account already has access to, and it deliberately never uses the separate app/bot authentication mode Google Chat also supports, keeping every action attributable to a real person's account.
